submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve precise pose correction. Produce ONE full-body transparent game animation frame, E12 of 16-frame running cycle of the Moon Shadow Assassin Girl. Input 1 is the exact old E12 EDIT TARGET for fixed canvas layout, scale, camera, lighting, face and costume. Input 2 is her confirmed E-facing identity reference. Input 3 is the primary approved painterly rendering reference only; do not render its UI, text or other figures. Keep the target's silver-lilac bob, single ahoge, purple right-facing profile eye, rounded Daoist chibi face, navy/ivory/gold clothing, scarf, crescent buckle, cyan beads, short baggy trousers and moon boots. Keep head, torso, body scale and pelvis position nearly identical to target; native square canvas ideally 1254x1254, at least 1024x1024, virtual contact ground y=94% of canvas. Preserve genuine RGBA transparency, with full weapons/scarf/boots safely inside canvas.
Change only running phase of the four articulated limbs and necessary sleeve/trouser folds. E12 is the second half-cycle transfer: anatomical LEFT leg is the FAR supporting leg, extending slightly back from the pelvis, its toe on the virtual ground just behind the hip, heel lifting; anatomical RIGHT leg is NEAR and swings forward, thigh only modestly raised, knee BENT about 90 degrees, right boot folded under the knee and CLEAR OFF GROUND. This must NOT be a forward extended boot landing pose, NOT a high-knee parade, NOT two-foot flight. Near/right knee advances while near/right ARM RETRACTS toward the hip: gold-disc near shoulder joins one cream sleeve bending down-and-back, the right fist is beside/slightly behind the belt. Far/left ARM advances through a low middle swing with bent elbow, its fist a little in front of abdomen. Exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs, TWO boots. Exactly TWO small curved crescent daggers, ONE locked in each closed gripping hand. Show clear thumb/finger grips and continuous shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist sleeves. Keep separate silhouettes for the two hands and daggers. No detached/floating weapons, no third arm/hand/dagger, no weapon switching. Left temple moon ornament stays FAR side and almost entirely hidden by hair in E view, only a tiny rear gold tip. Keep head and torso unchanged as much as possible; do not shift whole sprite, zoom, recenter to bounding box, mirror or duplicate another frame. No text, no grid, no floor, no shadow, no attack trails, no FX. Highest clean hand-painted finish matching references. Configuration target is GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max; actual host model is managed externally.
